title: Khoon Akbar Ka Kaleja Hogaya
body:
Khoon Akbar Ka Kaleja Hogaya
Nawjawani Tujse Shikwa Hogaya
Khalb Main Paywast Naiza Hogaya
Karwatoun Se Zakhm Gayra Hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Maut Run Main Loriyaa Dethi Rahi
Dasthe Shay Asgar Ka Jula Hogaya
Taza Taza Dekkar Akbar Ki Laash
Zindagi Ka Maa Ko Dhoka Hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala Qasim Ki Shaadi Youn Kuiee
Khoon Se Range Hai Sehra Hogaya
Phool Sehray Kay Bikhar Kar Ragaey
Gadoun Se Pamal Dula Hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Nawjawani Ki Qasam Khakar Uto
Aey Ali Akbar Savera Hogaya
Shaam Se Paulay Khule Zainab Ke Baal
Saari Dunya Main Andhera Hogaya
